### Pioneer Power Begins Converting PRYMUS Quote Pipeline into Commercial Wins, with Significant Growth Opportunities Ahead


*First PRYMUS Lease Agreement for 2.4 MW Expected to Generate Approximately $700,000 in Annual Revenue*


*PRYMUS Commercialization Accelerating, Positioning Platform for Significant Scale and Long-term Growth*


**Fort Lee, NJ, November 23, 2026** – Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPSI) (“Pioneer” or the “Company”), a provider of distributed energy resources, power generation equipment and mobile electric vehicle (“EV”) charging solutions, today announced progress in converting its growing pipeline of active PRYMUS quotes into commercial orders, securing an award for two 1.2 MW PRYMUS natural gas-powered distributed generation systems. The order marks Pioneer’s first PRYMUS lease agreement and provides an early indication of the commercial opportunities beginning to materialize following the Company’s recent business update.


The customer, a nationwide provider of off-grid natural gas power solutions serving the oil and gas industry, plans to deploy the PRYMUS systems to supplement its existing fleet of natural gas turbines during periods of peak power demand. Each 1.2 MW system is expected to consist of three paralleled 400 kW natural gas-powered generator sets and a common bus connection unit. Delivery and lease commencement are scheduled for December 2026, with the agreement expected to generate approximately $700,000 in annual lease revenue for Pioneer.


The customer anticipates needing an additional 7.2 MW of generating capacity in 2027, which, if materializes, would quadruple Pioneer’s initial deployment. Discussions regarding the six additional PRYMUS systems are in advanced stages, with a decision anticipated in early 2027.


“As demand for power continues to accelerate and existing infrastructure struggles to keep pace, customers increasingly need reliable, scalable power solutions that can be deployed quickly to meet both immediate and expanding needs,” said Nathan J. Mazurek, Chairman and CEO of Pioneer. “We believe these market dynamics represent a significant and growing opportunity for PRYMUS, with our more than $200 million pipeline of quoted opportunities reflecting substantial customer demand and breadth of the markets we are addressing. This initial award is an important milestone and, in our view, an early indication of the broader commercial opportunity ahead. By maintaining a large generator inventory, quickly securing ancillary equipment and leveraging PRYMUS’s modular design, we believe we can deliver generating capacity faster and respond to opportunities that would otherwise require six to 12 months of lead time. With the potential to expand this initial 2.4 MW deployment to 9.6 MW, we believe there is a meaningful opportunity to grow with this customer while building our broader PRYMUS business and generating predictable, recurring monthly lease revenue.”


**PRYMUS: Energy-at-the-Edge, Fast and Scalable**


PRYMUS is a distributed power package designed to deliver scalable, pre-engineered energy blocks of 1 MW up to 10 MW. The Company believes its primary differentiators are speed and mobility. PRYMUS is designed to be delivered and fully operational at a site in approximately six months, drastically reducing the typical two- to three-year timeline for securing utility-grade power. This fast-track deployment is essential for modular data centers testing new server racks with the latest AI chipsets, including next-generation NVIDIA AI chipsets, all of which require ultra-stable power delivery and rapid response to extreme load variability.


PRYMUS also supports industrial automation and on-premise AI compute required by sectors such as healthcare, pharma, finance, research institutions and government, where data privacy regulations, strict compliance and IP protection necessitate local data processing.


**About Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc.**


Pioneer Power Solutions, Inc. is a leader in the design, manufacture, integration, service of distributed energy resources, power generation equipment and mobile electric charging solutions for applications in the utility, industrial and commercial markets. To learn more about Pioneer, please visit its website at www.pioneerpowersolutions.com.


e-Boost is Pioneer’s portfolio of smart, mobile EV charging solutions designed for speed, flexibility, and sustainability. Since its launch in November 2021, e-Boost has established itself as the market leader, delivering mobile, off-grid charging solutions with an extensive range of platforms. Utilized by electric bus and truck manufacturers, fleet management companies, municipalities, and EV infrastructure providers, e-Boost is setting the standard for innovative, all-inclusive EV charging solutions. To learn more about Pioneer’s e-Boost, please visit its website at www.pioneer-emobility.com.


PRYMUS is Pioneer’s advanced power systems and controls platform focused on delivering resilient, intelligent, and scalable energy solutions for utility, industrial, and critical infrastructure applications. PRYMUS supports customers through innovative engineering, system integration, and power management technologies designed to improve reliability, operational efficiency, and grid performance.


PowerJunction is Pioneer’s distributed energy and infrastructure solutions platform, providing customers with flexible and sustainable power solutions for standby, prime, and mobile power applications. PowerJunction supports a wide range of commercial, industrial, utility, and infrastructure projects through integrated power generation, energy management, and deployment capabilities.
